corpus.data_policy: Visible messages and observed responses only; no server reasons, private scores or future evidence. Final-offer counters are observed risk examples, never instructions to over-negotiate.

temporal_audit.rule: General-history rows must predate the earliest target validation/test boundary; final deployment refits may use all observations. Test labels never choose a variant.

splits.scope: later attempts on these same suppliers; not unseen-supplier generalization

limitations: Observed next-quote prediction, not proof of better deals or higher scores.
Historical data already studied; a prospective comparison is still needed.
Business records are largely constant per supplier/case, so apparent benefit may reflect identity.
Only dated numeric record features enter weights; full documents remain retrievable evidence.
Demo and practice histories are balanced by case and session; synthetic local sessions are excluded.
